_doc: Source of truth for game_store_navigation. inputs/ and expected/ are GENERATED from this file + site_src/ by build_cases.py -- edit here, never there. Every `gold` value is derived mechanically from site_src/games.json + bundle-data*.json by build_cases.py's self-check (see verify_gold_answers()), not hand-typed independently, to avoid the exact kind of manual-arithmetic drift that motivated that check.
